menuFlow.staticCause: inspectEasyWebMenuFlow reclassifies sources separately and matches UI cards by label/category/action/navigate-href/relatedLabel. Distinct locate sources with the same label therefore have sourceMatches=2 and sourceId=null. observeMenuFlow then uses source:<label> as a fallback repeat key, conflating distinct original controls. Public-agency has two original accepted controls each for lookup, certificate issuance, report/application and search; city has two matching ordinary application links.
menuFlow.evidenceAgainstPrematureProductConclusio: rank deduplicates locate controls by HTMLElement and remainingMenus keeps a Set of already shown HTMLElement identities. Static code supports distinct same-named source controls being labeled repeats, but recorded UI cards do not preserve enough identity to prove which source each represented. No S05/action safety defect is inferred.
menuFlow.nextDiagnostic: Preserve this first report.
